notes: PROTECTED-NOTE SCENARIO. ERP psychotherapy session for established OCD. Ground-truth property: therapeutic/process content must NOT be extracted into coded resources. Only the established billing diagnosis (Condition) and the billable therapy service (Procedure CPT 90834) are chart-visible; the process content is carried in a Composition with confidentiality=R and v3 ActCode PSY security label (psychotherapy note, 45 CFR 164.501). A faithful extraction yields a thin coded set plus a protected note, never a pile of billing codes mined from process. Maps to BH panel patient ocd (Branden Shields).
